tagline: Your team assesses together how much each person contributed to the result – and talks about it openly.
step_1: Everyone briefly says what they did.
step_2: Everyone distributes 100 % across the team on their phone, including themselves.
step_3: You see an interim result and talk about it.
step_4: You assess once more. That result counts.
landing_facts: For teams of 3 to 9 people. Everyone needs a phone. Anyone not in the room can join by video call. The rating itself takes only a few minutes; most of the time goes to the conversation.
anon_text: Nobody sees who gave how much to whom. Individual ratings are deleted after the calculation. Only the overall result with names is visible.
calc_1: Your share is the average of what the others give you.
calc_2: If your self-assessment differs from that, your share is reduced: hardly at all for small differences, clearly for large ones. Overestimating yourself costs twice as much as underestimating.
calc_3: Example: the others see you at 10 %. If you give yourself 12 %, about 9.7 % remains. If you give yourself 20 %, about 5.3 % remains. What is deducted goes to the others.
percent_only: The tool only outputs percentages. What you distribute with them is up to you.
create_hint: One name per line. Add your own too. Someone who is missing today still goes on the list and is marked “missing” in the next step: the others will rate that person as well.
invite_hint: Everyone opens this link on their own phone. In the room: scan the QR code. On a video call: post the link in the chat.
confirm_reset: “{name}” is already taken. Is that you? Then the name moves to this phone and everything from the other phone is discarded.
lobby_now: Now: everyone briefly says what they did and achieved during this period. Then everyone deliberately taps “Start”.
know_1: In a moment you will distribute 100 % across everyone on the team, including yourself.
know_2: Nobody sees who gave how much to whom.
know_3: Assess yourself honestly: if you are far from how the others see you, your share is reduced.
show_label: My self-assessment may be shown to everyone (this only happens if everyone agrees).
promise_1: to give feedback honestly and constructively, with examples and facts
promise_2: to accept radical feedback from the others as well
voluntary: Taking part is voluntary. It gives you the chance to get feedback, but does not oblige you to. If you do not want to take part, tell the group before the start.
absent_hint: Someone is not taking part in person (holiday, illness)? Tap “missing” next to the name. The person is still rated by you and gets a share.
lobby_waiting: Round 1 starts as soon as everyone is ready.
confirm_absent_lobby: {name} is missing today? Then {name} does not rate, but is rated by you and gets a share. This can be undone before the start.
confirm_absent_later: {name} cannot continue? Then {name} no longer rates, but is still rated by you. This cannot be undone.
notice_reset: The name {name} was moved to another phone.
you_absent_lobby: You are marked as absent. The others will rate you as well.
you_removed: You are marked as absent and no longer rate. The others still rate you, and you get a share.
rate_now: Now: distribute 100 % across everyone. How much did each person contribute to the result?
rate_penalty: If your self-assessment is far from how the others see you, your share is reduced.
round2_now: Now: assess once more – with what you heard in the conversation. This round counts.
round2_hint: The closer your self-assessment is to how the others see you, the smaller the deduction. Overestimating yourself costs twice as much as underestimating.
last_hint: Everyone else has submitted. The round closes when you submit.
warn_equal: Almost equal for all – did everyone really contribute the same?
submitted: Your rating has been submitted. You can change it until everyone has submitted.
own_line: You gave yourself {s}; the others gave you {f} on average.
own_over: You see your contribution as higher than the others do. That happens to many people: you see your own work best.
own_over_talk: In the conversation, tell the others what they may not have seen.
own_under: The others see your contribution as higher than you do.
own_match: Your assessment is close to how the others see you.
share_hint: Share: average of the others, reduced where the self-assessment differs, and scaled to 100 %.
discuss_now: Now: talk about the result. One after another, everyone says:
talk_1: How do I feel about the result?
talk_2: What did I do that you may not have seen?
talk_3: What did I base my rating of the others on?
discuss_after: Then talk freely. Surprise and annoyance are normal: ask questions instead of defending yourselves.
rule_1: Talk about the work, not the person.
rule_2: Give concrete examples instead of general judgements.
rule_4: Listen without defending yourself right away.
rule_5: Ask if a rating surprises you.
ready2_hint: Tap only when the conversation is finished for you.
ready2_waiting: Round 2 starts as soon as everyone is ready.
final_text: You gave each other open feedback – that’s not something to take for granted. Here is your final distribution. The numbers do not rate you as people, but the contribution to this work.
final_now: Now: to finish, everyone says one sentence in turn: what do I take away from this session?
final_rule: No discussion and no comments from the others. The distribution is final.
tb_accuracy_noticeable: There are noticeable differences between self-assessment and others’ view.
tb_accuracy_strong: There are strong differences between self-assessment and others’ view.
tb_direction_realistic: On average, you assess yourselves realistically.
tb_convergence_closer: After the conversation, your self-assessments are closer to the others’ view.
tb_convergence_apart: After the conversation, your self-assessments are further from the others’ view.
tb_convergence_same: The gap between self-assessment and others’ view has hardly changed.
feedback_title: How did you like the tool?
delete_hint: All data is deleted automatically after 30 days. From one day after the final result, any participant can delete the session earlier.
confirm_delete: Delete the session permanently? This cannot be undone.
err_calc: Calculation error, please create a new session.
err_network: No connection to the server. Please try again.
err_duplicate_name: Each name may only appear once.
err_name_too_long: One of the names is too long (max. 30 characters).
err_removed: This person is marked as absent.
err_phase: This isn’t possible at this step.
err_too_early: Deleting is only possible one day after the final result.
err_not_auth: Your phone is no longer signed in for this name.
err_busy: The server is busy right now. Please try again.
err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err_feedback_empty: Please give stars or write a text.
